all: Judges read each option text as a claim and evaluate it from statement/figure/params; keyed letter is only compared after, never used to derive. No letter map. Geometry classifiers copied from geometry_coordinate_6/10 then given a second method (collinear: distances; triangle: vertex dot products; conic: eigenvalue signs; skew lines: linsolve; aspar: direction vectors).
alcyc: formula-based (converse of cyclic-quadrilateral / same-side equal-angle / opposite-side supplementary theorems); no independent numeric cross-check. 'cannot be decided' option treated as false because angles are given.
alnear: two statement variants (distances given / lengths given); options are per-variant claim sets (longer vs nearer); exact squared quantities.
mutation: keyed letter shifted +1 mod option count; every decided question must flip to mismatch (all 10 families: 100%).
numberFamilies: options parsed from option texts; options equal the prompt list in the same order for all questions (checked), so the earlier assumed A..D order is now confirmed by real texts.
